title: Ghazi Dai Baad Zainab (S.A)
body:
Ghazi dai baad Zainab, sir di rida luta kai bari dair tayeen royi.
Jadon khaimain jal gayai sarn’, seenay alaam nu laa kay baari dair tayeen royi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra di laadli day, hathan ch’ rasiyan paakay
Makhdooma do alam di / balaan ch’ mun luka kai
Bari dair tayeen royi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloomay Karbala da / puchyaan’ jadon muhari
Ehwaal Karbala da, Sajaad nu suran’ kay
Bari dair tayeen royi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Raiya maar’da tamanchay / ruksaar tay kameena
Zainab bhira di dhi day, sholay to agg bujha kay
Bari dair tayeen royi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri sairn’ apnay sir vich / Karbal di khaak payee
Abbas bawafa di / gal naal mashk laa kai
Bari dair tayeen royi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kubra nu seenay laa kay / roiya batool jaya
Gathri batool jaayi / Farwa di jholi paa kay
Bari dair tayeen royi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadon godiyan ch’ chaa kay / bachray khila ay maavaan’
Aay Bibi ladli day / jholi ch’ chola paa kai
Bari dair tayeen royi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Deen-e-khuda di jis nay / tauqeer hay vadahi
